certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Multiplication and Division (Ages 8-10)

learning_outcomes.text: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and equal groups
Recall multiplication facts for common tables
Understand division as sharing and as grouping
Use the link between multiplication and division fact families
Solve word problems involving multiplication and division
Interpret and handle remainders in simple problems

integrative_case: Plan party bags for a class celebration: decide how many treats go in each bag, use multiplication to find the total needed, and use division to share a box of treats fairly, deciding what to do with any left over.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
